title: Wso2am: Netty is a network application framework for development of protocol servers and clients (CVE-2026-47244)
description: A medium severity security vulnerability (CVE-2026-47244) affects the wso2am package, which uses Netty, a network application framework for protocol servers and clients. The vulnerability impacts versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. It does not affect confidentiality or integrity but can cause availability issues. A patch is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
